title: Online Election
description: Find the leader of an election at a given time t using precomputed lead history and binary search.
pseudocode:
1. Precompute leaders at each time t using a hash map for counts.
2. Store pairs of (time, leader) in a list.
3. For each query q(t), binary search for the latest time <= t.
4. Return the leader associated with that time.

steps.note: Initialize count map and leaders array.
Time 0: person 0 gets vote. Count: {0:1}. Current leader: 0.
Time 5: person 1 gets vote. Count: {0:1, 1:1}. Leader: 1 (recent vote wins).
Time 10: person 1 gets vote. Count: {0:1, 1:2}. Leader: 1.
Time 15: person 0 gets vote. Count: {0:2, 1:2}. Leader: 0 (recent vote wins).
Query q(3): Binary search time 3 in [0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30]. Latest time <= 3 is 0. Leader: 0.
Query q(12): Binary search time 12. Latest time <= 12 is 10. Leader: 1.
Query q(25): Binary search time 25. Latest time <= 25 is 25. Leader: 1.
